name: Personal Training

emergency: race or competition in a few days

extra_prompt: You are booking for a personal training business. Ask about goals, current fitness level, injuries or medical conditions, and availability. Ask whether they prefer one-on-one, partner, or group. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed after the first session. Do not provide medical advice or promise a specific result that is not in the reference answers.

kb.q: How much does PT cost?
kb.a: {price_note} PT is priced per session or per package. Tell us your goals and availability, and we will confirm the price that applies to you.

kb.q: Do you offer a first consultation?
kb.a: {consult_note} We use the first session to learn your goals, health history and current fitness level. We then plan your training from there.

kb.q: Do you do online coaching?
kb.a: Yes, we offer online programming and video sessions. Your program is built around your goals, equipment and schedule.

kb.q: Do you do nutrition coaching?
kb.a: Yes, we offer nutrition coaching alongside training. It is priced per month, and we confirm the scope when we set up your plan.

kb.q: Do you train at my home?
kb.a: Yes, mobile PT is available in the local metro area. Ask us to confirm your suburb and what equipment you have at home.

kb.q: Do you train at a gym?
kb.a: Yes, we train at partner gyms and outdoor locations. Tell us which location suits you when you book, and we will confirm the address.

kb.q: Do you do small group training?
kb.a: Yes, small groups of 2 to 6 people are available. Group sessions are priced per person, so you only pay for your own place.

kb.q: Do you do pre/post natal training?
kb.a: Yes, we train pre and postnatal clients with written clearance from your health provider. Tell us about your pregnancy or recent birth when you book.

kb.q: Do you train seniors?
kb.a: Yes, we train seniors and offer falls-prevention programs. Sessions start with a review of your mobility and any conditions your doctor has discussed with you.

kb.q: Do you do boxing?
kb.a: Yes, we offer boxing sessions with pad work. Tell us your experience level when you book, and we will confirm what equipment is supplied.

kb.q: Do you do yoga or pilates?
kb.a: Yes, one-on-one and small group yoga and pilates sessions are available. Tell us your experience level so we can match you with the right session.

kb.q: Do you do rehab?
kb.a: Yes, we offer exercise-based rehab. We do not replace physiotherapy, so if you have a diagnosed injury we may ask for clearance from your physio or doctor first.

kb.q: How many sessions per week?
kb.a: Most clients train two to three times per week, though this depends on your goals and recovery. We will suggest a frequency during your consultation.

kb.q: Do you offer packages?
kb.a: Yes, we offer 5-session and 10-session packages. Ask us about the validity period for each package before you buy.

kb.q: What if I need to cancel?
kb.a: Cancelling with less than {cancellation_notice} may incur a fee. Please tell us as early as you can, and we will help you move the session.

kb.q: Are you certified?
kb.a: Our trainers hold [your qualification or certification] and [your insurance details]. Ask us for copies before you book.

kb.q: Do you offer body composition scans?
kb.a: Yes, we offer body composition scans and progress tracking. A scan is taken at the start, and it can be repeated to track your progress over time.

kb.q: Can I get a program without training?
kb.a: Yes, we offer standalone program design. You receive a written program that you can follow on your own, and we can review it with you.

kb.q: How do I book my first session?
kb.a: Contact us with your goals, availability and any injuries. We will then confirm a time for your initial consultation and answer any questions first.

kb.q: What if I have an injury?
kb.a: Tell us at booking if you have an injury or medical condition. We may ask for clearance from your health provider before your first session.

compliance.guidance: Fitness instructors should keep first aid and public liability insurance current. Keep health screening records for clients where the service offers them.
items: Health screening records kept with the client
